detail.caution: Widely quoted, but its chain is weak. Seek mercy, forgiveness and release throughout Ramadan, not only in these ten days.

iftar.title: Breaking the fast

rahmat1.title: Asking for mercy
rahmat1.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.

rahmat2.title: Seeking help through His mercy
rahmat2.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help.

rahmat3.title: Mercy for me and my family
rahmat3.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

maghfirat1.title: Asking for pardon
maghfirat1.translation: O Allah, You are the Pardoner and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

maghfirat2.title: The dua of Adam
maghfirat2.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

maghfirat3.title: Seeking forgiveness
maghfirat3.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.

nijat1.title: Good in both worlds
nijat1.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

nijat2.title: Asking for Jannah
nijat2.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.

nijat3.title: Protection from the Fire
nijat3.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

help.title: How Zakat is calculated
steps: Add up what you own: cash, gold, silver, business stock, money owed to you and investments.
Subtract debts and bills that are due now.
If what remains is at least the nisab and you have held it for one lunar year, pay 2.5% of it.
Things you use personally, such as your home, car and furniture, are not counted. Gold and silver jewellery is included.

nisab.title: Choose your nisab basis
nisab.body: Zakat is due when your net wealth reaches the nisab and you have held it for one lunar year.
nisab.silverNote: The lower threshold, so more Zakat reaches people in need.
nisab.goldNote: Use if most of your wealth is held in gold.

liabilities.title: What do you owe?
liabilities.body: Only amounts that are due now are deducted from your wealth.
liabilities.note: For long-term loans such as a home loan, scholars differ. A common approach is to deduct only the instalments due in the next 12 months.

newYear.title: Islamic New Year
newYear.body: 1 Muharram begins the Hijri year and the sacred month of Muharram.

sacredStart.title: A sacred month begins
sacredStart.body: One of the four sacred months, when good deeds and wrongs both weigh more.

tasua.title: Tasu'a fast
tasua.body: Fasting the 9th alongside Ashura, as the Prophet ﷺ intended.

ashura.title: Day of Ashura
ashura.body: Fasting Ashura expiates the sins of the previous year.

mawlid.title: 12 Rabi al-Awwal
mawlid.body: Commonly given as the date of the Prophet's ﷺ birth. A public holiday in Bangladesh.

bid.title: Ayyam al-Bid fast
bid.body: Fasting the 13th, 14th and 15th of each Hijri month is sunnah.

miraj.title: Shab-e-Miraj · Isra & Mi'raj
miraj.body: Observed on the night of 26–27 Rajab. Historians differ on the exact date.

barat.title: Shab-e-Barat · Mid-Sha'ban
barat.body: Allah looks upon His creation on this night and forgives all but those who associate partners with Him or hold enmity.

ramadanStart.title: Ramadan begins
ramadanStart.body: The month of fasting. Dates depend on the moon sighting.

qadr.title: 27th night of Ramadan
qadr.body: One of the odd nights of the last ten, when Laylatul Qadr is sought.

eidFitr.title: Eid al-Fitr
eidFitr.body: Pay Zakat al-Fitr before the Eid prayer. Fasting is not allowed today.

arafah.title: Day of Arafah
arafah.body: Fasting Arafah expiates the sins of the previous year and the coming year.

eidAdha.title: Eid al-Adha
eidAdha.body: The day of sacrifice. Fasting is not allowed today.

tashreeq.title: Days of Tashreeq
tashreeq.body: Days of eating, drinking and remembering Allah. Fasting is not allowed.

motherLanguage.title: International Mother Language Day
motherLanguage.body: Shaheed Dibosh, a national day in Bangladesh.

boishakh.title: Pohela Boishakh
boishakh.body: Bangla New Year, a national holiday in Bangladesh.

month.addedToast: Added to Today's Amol on the days it applies

months.muharram: “…of them, four are sacred.” Muharram is one of the four. The best fasting after Ramadan is in Allah's month, Muharram.
months.safar: No special acts of worship are tied to Safar. The Prophet ﷺ rejected the belief that Safar brings bad luck.
months.rabiAwwal: The month the Prophet ﷺ was born. Asked about fasting on Mondays, he said: “That is the day I was born.”
months.rabiAkhir: No special acts of worship are tied to this month. Keep up the sunnah practices of every month.
months.jumadaUla: No special acts of worship are tied to this month. Keep up the sunnah practices of every month.
months.jumadaAkhirah: No special acts of worship are tied to this month. Keep up the sunnah practices of every month.
months.rajab: “…of them, four are sacred.” Rajab is one of the four. Good deeds weigh more in these months, and so do wrongs.
months.shaban: The Prophet ﷺ fasted more in Sha'ban than in any month besides Ramadan. It is a month people neglect, when deeds are raised to Allah.
months.ramadan: “The month of Ramadan, in which the Quran was revealed.” Whoever fasts it with faith, seeking reward, is forgiven his past sins.
months.shawwal: Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted the whole year.
months.dhulQadah: “…of them, four are sacred.” Dhul-Qa'dah is one of the four. The Prophet ﷺ performed his Umrahs in this month.
months.dhulHijjah: No days are better for good deeds than the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah.

monThu.title: Fast on Mondays & Thursdays
monThu.body: Deeds are presented to Allah on these two days.

guard.title: Guard against wrongdoing
guard.body: Sins and good deeds both carry more weight in the sacred months.

ashura.title: Fast on Ashura
ashura.body: 10 Muharram. It expiates the previous year.

mondayBirth.title: Fast on Mondays
mondayBirth.body: The day the Prophet ﷺ was born, and Thursdays too.

salawat.title: Send salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
salawat.body: Whoever sends one, Allah sends ten upon him.

rajabDua.title: Dua for Rajab & Sha'ban
rajabDua.body: Weak chain. Fine to say as a general dua.

sacredFasts.title: Extra fasts in the sacred months
sacredFasts.body: Voluntary fasting, without singling out Rajab alone.

shabanFast.title: Fast more in Sha'ban
shabanFast.body: As the Prophet ﷺ did, to prepare for Ramadan.

barat.title: Worship on the night of mid-Sha'ban
barat.body: Night of 14–15 Sha'ban. Seek forgiveness and mend broken ties.

taraweeh.title: Pray Taraweeh
taraweeh.body: Standing in prayer at night in Ramadan.

qadr.title: Seek Laylatul Qadr
qadr.body: In the odd nights of the last ten.

shawwalSix.title: Fast six days of Shawwal
shawwalSix.body: Any six days after Eid, together or apart.

eidDates.title: Eat dates before the Eid prayer
eidDates.body: An odd number, as the Prophet ﷺ did on Eid al-Fitr.

tenDays.title: Increase good deeds
tenDays.body: 1–10 Dhul-Hijjah: dhikr, fasting, charity and prayer.

arafah.title: Fast on the Day of Arafah
arafah.body: 9 Dhul-Hijjah, if you are not on Hajj.

udhiyah.title: Offer the Udhiyah
udhiyah.body: After the Eid prayer on 10 Dhul-Hijjah.

tashreeq.title: Don't fast on 11–13 Dhul-Hijjah
tashreeq.body: The days of Tashreeq are for eating, drinking and remembering Allah.

leaveHome.title: Leaving the home
leaveHome.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
leaveHome.virtue: Whoever says this is told: you are guided, sufficed and protected.

forgotBismillah.title: If you forgot to say Bismillah
forgotBismillah.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.

afterEating.title: After eating
afterEating.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from me.
afterEating.virtue: Whoever says this has his past sins forgiven.

enterMasjid.title: Entering the masjid
enterMasjid.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

leaveMasjid.title: Leaving the masjid
leaveMasjid.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

enterToilet.title: Entering the toilet
enterToilet.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil ones.

beforeSleeping.title: Before sleeping
beforeSleeping.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

waking.title: On waking up
waking.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.

parents.title: For parents
parents.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.

sayyidulIstighfar.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
sayyidulIstighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
sayyidulIstighfar.virtue: Whoever says it with certainty in the day and dies before evening, or at night and dies before morning, is of the people of Paradise.

noHarm.title: Protection from harm
noHarm.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
noHarm.virtue: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm him.

subhanallah.title: Glorifying Allah
subhanallah.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
subhanallah.virtue: No one brings anything better on the Day of Resurrection, except one who said the same or more.

tahlil.title: Declaring Allah's oneness
tahlil.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things.
tahlil.virtue: Said 100 times a day, it equals freeing ten slaves and is a protection from Shaytan until evening.

afiyah.title: Asking for well-being
afiyah.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
afiyah.virtue: The opening of a longer morning and evening dua.

afterWudu.title: After wudu
afterWudu.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
afterWudu.virtue: The eight gates of Paradise are opened for him to enter by whichever he wishes.

afterAdhan.title: After the adhan
afterAdhan.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger and with Islam as religion.
afterAdhan.virtue: Whoever says this has his sins forgiven.

opening.title: Opening the prayer
opening.translation: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

ruku.title: In ruku
ruku.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

sujud.title: In sujud
sujud.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

betweenSujud.title: Between the two prostrations
betweenSujud.translation: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.

afterSalam.title: After the salam
afterSalam.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

helpMe.title: Help in worship
helpMe.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You well.

travel.title: Setting out on a journey
travel.translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it ourselves, and to our Lord we will surely return.
travel.virtue: The opening of the travel dua, said after three takbirs.

stopping.title: Stopping at a place
stopping.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
stopping.virtue: Nothing will harm him until he leaves that place.

ascending.title: Going up and coming down
ascending.translation: Allah is the Greatest when going up; glory be to Allah when coming down.

farewell.title: Seeing off a traveller
farewell.translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust and the end of your deeds.

returning.title: Returning from a journey
returning.translation: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

iftar.title: Breaking the fast
iftar.translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

qadr.title: Laylatul Qadr
qadr.translation: O Allah, You are the Pardoner and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

host.title: Thanking an iftar host
host.translation: May the fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels send blessings upon you.

newMoon.title: Seeing the new moon
newMoon.translation: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

lailaha.label: La ilaha illallah
lailaha.meaning: There is no god but Allah

names.title: Islamic Names
names.noMatch: No names match these choices. Try another letter or syllable count.
names.noFavoritesBody: Tap the heart on a name to keep it here.
names.meaningNote: Meanings of names are approximate; scholars of Arabic sometimes differ.

items.ihsan: Excellence; doing good as if you see Allah
items.luqman: The wise man named in the Quran
items.ibrahim: Prophet Ibrahim (as), the friend of Allah
items.ahmad: Most praised; a name of the Prophet ﷺ
items.hamza: Strong, steadfast; the Prophet's ﷺ uncle
items.zayd: Growth, increase; the only Companion named in the Quran
items.khadijah: First wife of the Prophet ﷺ
items.sumayyah: High; the first martyr of Islam
